seo.title: Restaurant POS Solutions by Service Type | RestaBee
seo.description: Explore RestaBee POS solutions for cafes, quick service counters, takeaway restaurants, cloud kitchens and bakeries. Find the workflow that fits your team.

copy.heroTitle: A POS workflow for the way you serve.
copy.heroDescription: Start with your service model. Explore how RestaBee supports order entry, preparation, billing and reporting across cafes, quick service counters, takeaway desks, cloud kitchens and bakeries.
copy.directoryDescription: Each solution page focuses on a service style and the work its team handles every day. Follow a route to see its menu setup, order handoffs and operating views.
copy.workflowTitle: The same connected workflow, shaped around service.
copy.workflowDescription: Teams can enter dine-in, takeaway and staff-entered delivery orders, send preparation details to the assigned station, and continue through bill preparation and collection. The pages below show how that workflow applies to different restaurant formats.
copy.ctaTitle: See the workflow that fits your restaurant.
copy.ctaDescription: Talk through your service style, outlet setup and the screens your team uses.

solutionDirectory.title: Cafe POS
solutionDirectory.description: Set up drink sizes and add-ons, take counter or dine-in orders, route preparation details and review item sales.

solutionDirectory.title: QSR POS
solutionDirectory.description: Manage counter orders, combos and modifiers, then send items into the configured kitchen station workflow.

solutionDirectory.title: Takeaway POS
solutionDirectory.description: Record staff-entered takeaway orders, capture packaging charges where configured and carry the order through preparation and billing.

solutionDirectory.title: Cloud Kitchen POS
solutionDirectory.description: Organise staff-entered delivery orders, menu choices, station handoffs and bill details across the kitchen workflow.

solutionDirectory.title: Bakery POS
solutionDirectory.description: Handle counter sales, menu variants, cake notes and pickup details alongside preparation, billing and daily reporting.
